o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *bīrinč (“first”). By surface analysis, bir + -inci.

The reconstruction *bākana is improbably due to the lack of a long vowel in any cognate. Possibly from a Mongolic source, ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *baga.
Cognates
Cognate with Turkish bağan (“skin of dead-born lamb”), dialectal Khorezmian Uzbek bagʻana (“ship skin”), Turkmen bagana (“ship skin”), Kyrgyz баглан (baglan, “lamb”), Kyrgyz багылдыр (bagıldır, “wild lamb”)
